title: Define a pathway for person-generated and patient-reported data
requirements:
- Describe an optional pathway for citizen- and device-generated data under consent
- Support standardised collection and tracking of PROs
- Allow individuals and authorised carers to contribute structured and narrative information to the LHR with provenance
- Consider whether and how patient data input to DPI-H should be required, bound by the national principles
- Clarify when consumer technologies outside DPI-H become subject to its controls
- Address multi-vendor device interoperability free of identifiable data
